title: Surreal Painted Face
description: Close-up portrait of a person's face and upper chest, partially covered in thick, textured oil paint. The left side features vibrant green and yellow tones with magenta coral-like growths emerging from the cheek and jaw, while the right side displays flowing blue and red organic forms resembling underwater flora against a dark, atmospheric background with blurred floral elements.
